default_zone.description: The default zone applied to new interfaces and connections if no other zone matches.

minimize_rules.description: If true, only load rules required for the active zones on firewalld start.

log_denied.description: Enable logging of denied packets: 'off', 'unicast', 'broadcast', 'multicast', or 'all'.

rich_logging.description: If true, log rich language rules separately.

conntrack.description: If true, enable connection tracking (required for stateful packet inspection).

masquerade.description: If true, enable IPv4 masquerading (NAT) in the default zone.

forward.description: If true, enable IPv4 packet forwarding between zones.

forward_ipv6.description: If true, enable IPv6 packet forwarding between zones.

services.description: List of services to allow in the default zone. Each service name corresponds to a service file in /usr/lib/firewalld/services/ or /etc/firewalld/services/.

trusted_interfaces.description: List of interface names that should be treated as trusted (traffic bypasses firewall rules).

dns_forward.description: If true, forward DNS queries to configured DNS servers.

dns_servers.description: List of IP addresses to which DNS queries should be forwarded when dns_forward is enabled.

icmp_rate_limit.description: If true, apply rate limiting to ICMPv4 traffic.

icmpv6_rate_limit.description: If true, apply rate limiting to ICMPv6 traffic.
